policy.source_gate_rule: DOI landing pages, Crossref metadata, abstracts, review articles, textbooks, and repository landing pages without an accessible full-text bitstream do not release SOURCE_REQUIRED gates.
policy.secondary_formula_candidate_rule: Secondary formula transcriptions from reputable libraries, reviews, or engineering documentation are audit guidance only; they do not release SOURCE_REQUIRED gates and cannot be selected as published runtime physics.
policy.local_source_file_policy: Primary-source PDFs, scans, and extracted full text are local working evidence under sources/primary and are not committed. Released gates require SHA256, page/equation references, and an audit decision in docs/primary_source_inventory.md.
released_requirements: local_full_text_ref must identify the verified local full text under sources/primary
docs/primary_source_inventory.md must record the local file, SHA256, citation, audited pages/equations, and release decision
required_audit_checks must be completed in docs/formula_registry.md
required_tests_before_release must be implemented and passing
